name: ForecastBench
description: ForecastBench is a dynamic benchmark that evaluates the accuracy of machine learning systems on an automatically generated and regularly updated set of 1,000 forecasting questions about future events with no known answers at submission time.
reputation: Includes a public leaderboard and has been used to compare expert human forecasters, the general public, and LLMs.
notes: Questions are about future events with no known answers at submission to avoid data leakage.
